cards.whyItMattersEn: The benchmark moves LLM evaluation beyond factual or document-grounded QA toward the compute–implement–validate loop in quantitative finance, helping measure real usability in professional quantitative workflows. By releasing the dataset, evaluation scripts, and full backtesting configuration, it supports reproducible research and provides a basis for identifying key weaknesses such as multi-step reasoning and framework-constrained coding.
keyPoints: QuantEval 包含 1,575 个专家校验实例，覆盖知识问答、定量数学推理和量化策略编码三个互补维度。
策略编码任务通过确定性 CTA 风格回测执行模型生成策略，并与专家参考的风险收益指标比较，超越语法或模板匹配。
对 13 个开源与专有 LLM 的评估显示，模型与人类专家存在显著差距，尤其在多步推理和框架约束编码上；领域对齐数据的监督微调与强化学习可改善定量推理，但也暴露事实回忆的权衡。
cards.limitationsEn: The abstract does not provide specific scores by dimension or model, prompt design details, statistical significance, data sources and time ranges, or expert validation procedures and agreement metrics. Evaluation relies on a specific CTA-style backtesting framework and expert references, so transferability to other asset classes, market regimes, backtesting engines, or live trading environments is unclear. The scale, data composition, and magnitude of trade-offs in the supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning experiments are not quantified in the abstract, so no general training effect or investment applicability should be inferred.
cards.whyItMatters: 该基准将 LLM 评测从事实或文档问答推进到量化金融的计算—实现—验证闭环，有助于更真实地衡量模型在专业量化工作流中的可用性。公开发布数据集、评测脚本与完整回测配置，可支持可复现研究，并为识别模型在多步推理与框架约束编码等关键短板提供依据。
cards.limitations: 论文摘要未给出各维度、各模型的具体得分、提示设计细节、统计显著性、数据来源与时间范围，也未说明专家校验流程与一致性指标。评测基于特定 CTA 风格回测框架和专家参考，结论对其他资产类别、市场制度、回测引擎或实盘环境的可迁移性尚不明确。监督微调与强化学习实验的规模、数据构成和权衡幅度未在摘要中量化，因此不能据此推断普遍训练效果或投资适用性。
cards.title: QuantEval：面向量化金融的LLM计算—实现—验证评测基准
cards.description: QuantEval 针对大语言模型在专业量化工作流中评测碎片化、多停留在事实问答的缺口，提出覆盖知识问答、数学推理与策略编码三维度的专家校验基准。其编码任务使用确定性 CTA 风格回测框架执行模型生成策略并对比专家风险收益指标，而非仅做语法或模板匹配，因此更贴近量化研究中真实的计算—实现—验证闭环。该基准同时发布数据集、评测脚本与完整回测配置，便于可复现研究并暴露模型在多步推理和框架约束编码上的能力差距。
cards.summaryEn: The paper introduces QuantEval, a benchmark for evaluating whether LLMs can complete the compute–implement–validate loop required in quantitative finance, containing 1,575 expert-validated instances across knowledge-based QA, quantitative mathematical reasoning, and quantitative strategy coding. The coding task uses a deterministic CTA-style backtesting framework to execute model-generated strategies and compare risk–return metrics against expert references. Evaluating 13 open-source and proprietary LLMs reveals substantial gaps relative to human experts, especially in multi-step reasoning and framework-constrained coding; supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning on domain-aligned data can improve quantitative reasoning while exposing trade-offs in factual recall.
cards.titleEn: QuantEval: A Benchmark for LLMs in the Compute–Implement–Validate Loop of Quantitative Finance
cards.originalTitle: QuantEval: A Benchmark for Financial Quantitative Tasks in Large Language Models
cards.summary: 论文提出 QuantEval，一个用于评估大语言模型能否完成量化金融中计算—实现—验证闭环的基准，包含 1,575 个专家校验实例，覆盖知识问答、定量数学推理和量化策略编码三个维度。策略编码采用确定性 CTA 风格回测框架执行模型生成策略，并将风险收益指标与专家参考进行对比。论文评估了 13 个开源与专有 LLM，报告了提示与可靠性分析，并观察到模型与人类专家存在显著差距，尤其在多步推理和受框架约束的编码方面；此外，监督微调与强化学习实验显示训练可提升定量推理，但可能带来事实回忆上的权衡。
cards.descriptionEn: QuantEval addresses the fragmented evaluation of large language models in professional quantitative workflows, which often stops at factual or document-grounded QA. It introduces an expert-validated benchmark with three dimensions: knowledge-based QA, quantitative mathematical reasoning, and quantitative strategy coding. The coding task is evaluated with a deterministic CTA-style backtesting framework that executes model-generated strategies and compares risk–return metrics a
keyPointsEn: QuantEval contains 1,575 expert-validated instances spanning three complementary dimensions: knowledge-based QA, quantitative mathematical reasoning, and quantitative strategy coding.

The coding task executes model-generated strategies through a deterministic CTA-style backtesting framework and compares risk–return metrics against expert references, going beyond syntax or template matching.

Evaluation of 13 open-source and proprietary LLMs shows substantial gaps relative to human experts, especially in multi-step reasoning and framework-constrained coding; supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning on domain-aligned data can improve quantitative reasoning but also expose trade-offs in factual recall.

cards.whyItMattersEn: This work offers an interpretable volatility measurement and forecasting framework for prediction markets, useful for derivatives pricing, market making, and risk management, and shows that traditional ARCH/GARCH models are not optimal for binary probability contracts without incorporating market structure.
keyPoints: 模型将预测市场波动率分解为到期收敛组件与订单流组件，分别捕捉时间维度与交易维度的不确定性。
在Kalshi合约面板上，结构化变量显著优于纯ARCH/GARCH基准，且结构项设定条件方差水平、GARCH递归修正区间违例时机。
波动率在价格接近50%时最高、临近到期时上升，且不同类别合约的信息到达时机与离散程度存在差异。
cards.limitationsEn: Findings are based on a specific sample of Kalshi contracts; external validity across other prediction markets and time periods requires further testing. The model relies on structural assumptions from Wright-Fisher and Glosten-Milgrom mechanisms and does not cover all possible volatility sources. Re-estimating within categories did not improve out-of-sample performance, indicating pooled specifications transfer but category heterogeneity needs finer characterization. This does not constitute trading or investment advice.
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为预测市场提供了一种可解释的波动率测量与预测框架，有助于衍生品定价、做市与风险管理，同时表明传统ARCH/GARCH模型在二元概率合约上并非最优，需纳入市场结构特征。
cards.limitations: 研究基于Kalshi合约的特定样本，结论的外部有效性需在其他预测市场与时间段进一步检验；模型依赖Wright-Fisher与Glosten-Milgrom两类机制的结构假设，未涵盖所有可能的波动率来源；分类别重估计未提升样本外表现，说明池化设定适用但类别异质性仍待更细粒度刻画；不构成任何交易或投资建议。
cards.title: 预测市场二元合约波动率的结构化建模与预测
cards.description: 针对预测市场价格有界、收益二值、到期日已知的特殊结构，提出融合Wright-Fisher到期收敛机制与Glosten-Milgrom订单流机制的波动率模型，并在Kalshi大量合约上验证其预测能力优于单纯ARCH/GARCH。
cards.summaryEn: Prediction market prices are bounded probabilities with binary payoffs and known deadlines, making standard volatility models a poor fit. The authors develop a structural volatility model with a Wright-Fisher deadline-resolution component that captures forced binary uncertainty resolution over time and a Glosten-Milgrom order-flow component that captures informed trading via spreads and volume. Using a large panel of Kalshi contracts, structural variables show substantial forecasting power, dominating plain ARCH/GARCH benchmarks, with the best overall forecasts from scaling structural variance by a GARCH multiplier.
cards.titleEn: Structural Modeling and Forecasting of Volatility in Binary Prediction Market Contracts
cards.originalTitle: Volatility in Prediction Markets: A Structural Approach
cards.summary: 预测市场中的价格是[0,1]区间内的概率，收益为二值，且合约有已知到期日，这与传统资产市场的波动率建模假设不同。作者构建了一个结构化波动率模型，包含捕捉二元不确定性随时间强制消解的Wright-Fisher到期组件，以及捕捉知情交易影响的Glosten-Milgrom订单流组件。在Kalshi合约面板上，结构化变量具有显著预测力，纯ARCH/GARCH基准被结构化设定主导，而将结构化方差乘以GARCH乘数可获得最佳整体预测。
cards.descriptionEn: A structural volatility model for prediction markets is proposed, combining a Wright-Fisher deadline-resolution component and a Glosten-Mimrom order-flow component to capture binary uncertainty resolution and informed trading, validated on Kalshi contracts where it outperforms plain ARCH/GARCH benchmarks.
keyPointsEn: The model decomposes prediction market volatility into a deadline-resolution component and an order-flow component, capturing time-driven and trading-driven uncertainty respectively.

On Kalshi contract panels, structural variables significantly outperform plain ARCH/GARCH benchmarks, with the structural term setting the conditional variance level and the GARCH recursion correcting the timing of interval violations.
Volatility is highest near fifty-fifty prices, rises near resolution, and varies across categories with differences in the timing and discreteness of information arrival.

cards.whyItMattersEn: The work provides a theoretical bridge from parameter estimation error to policy value for data-driven dynamic portfolio selection, and empirically shows that combining simulated with historical data can reduce turnover without sacrificing growth, offering reference value for robustness and interpretability in quantitative strategies.
keyPoints: 方法融合藤Copula条件模拟与强化学习，在CVaR惩罚下训练循环组合策略。
理论上通过边对Copula参数误差传播，得到Hellinger距离与全变差下的幂律稳定性界。
在七资产面板上，十策略集成在22个完整月度持有期取得34.13%复合年增长率与2.31夏普比率，并降低目标换手41.5%。
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions are based on a specific seven-asset panel and 22 monthly holding periods of historical backtesting; out-of-sample and different market regime performance are unverified. The theoretical bounds rely on uniform local derivative bounds and approximation budgets whose practical satisfaction is untested. Transaction costs, market impact, and capacity constraints are not considered; the 41.5% turnover reduction is relative only within this setting.
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为数据驱动动态组合选择提供了从参数估计误差到策略价值的理论桥梁，并用经验结果展示模拟与历史数据结合可降低换手而不牺牲增长，对量化策略的稳健性与可解释性研究有参考价值。
cards.limitations: 结论基于特定七资产面板与22个月度持有期的历史回测，样本外与不同市场 regime 的表现未验证；理论界依赖均匀局部导数界与近似预算假设，实际满足程度未检验；未考虑交易成本、市场冲击与容量约束，41.5%换手下降仅为该设定下的相对值。
cards.title: 藤Copula模拟与强化学习驱动的动态组合选择
cards.description: 新在将藤Copula条件模拟与强化学习结合，用于CVaR约束下的动态组合选择，并给出参数误差传播的稳定性界。有用在于为数据驱动策略提供理论误差预算与可复现的经验表现。
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose a data-driven dynamic portfolio selection method combining vine copula simulation and reinforcement learning, maximizing expected terminal utility under CRRA with a running CVaR penalty on one-period losses. They estimate a conditional vine model from historical returns to generate joint scenarios for CVaR evaluation and train a recurrent policy on conditional paths. Under local derivative bounds they derive power-law stability bounds in Hellinger distance and total variation, and in a finite-horizon model combine these with approximation budgets to bound policy values, optimal values, and true-market loss.
cards.titleEn: Data-Driven Dynamic Portfolio Selection with Vine Copula Simulation and Reinforcement Learning
cards.originalTitle: Data-Driven Dynamic Portfolio Selection with Vine Copula Simulation and Reinforcement Learning
cards.summary: 作者提出一种数据驱动动态组合选择方法，结合藤Copula模拟与强化学习，在CRRA效用下最大化终端期望效用，并对单期损失CVaR施加连续惩罚。他们从历史收益估计条件藤模型，生成联合情景评估CVaR并训练循环策略。在局部导数界下推导Hellinger距离与全变差下的幂律稳定性界，并在有限期模型中结合近似预算给出策略值与真实市场损失的界。
cards.descriptionEn: Novelty lies in combining vine copula conditional simulation with reinforcement learning for CVaR-penalized dynamic portfolio selection, plus stability bounds from parameter error propagation. Utility lies in offering a theoretical error budget and reproducible empirical evidence for data-driven strategies.
keyPointsEn: The method integrates vine copula conditional simulation with reinforcement learning to train a recurrent portfolio policy under a CVaR penalty.
Theoretically, edgewise pair-copula parameter errors are propagated to obtain power-law stability bounds in Hellinger distance and total variation.
On a seven-asset panel, an ensemble of ten policies achieves 34.13% CAGR and 2.31 Sharpe over 22 complete monthly holding periods, with a 41.5% reduction in target-to-target turnover.

cards.whyItMattersEn: If reproducible on broader data and tasks, this framework could reduce reliance on discrete grid search for kernel tuning and lower the time cost of large-scale SVM training, offering a more scalable path for high-dimensional nonlinear classification.
keyPoints: 将核超参数学习与SVM对偶变量优化统一为连续双层次联合优化问题。
结合块坐标上升与Nyström低秩近似，将计算复杂度降至O(Nm)。
在生物信息、金融、网络安全与计算机视觉四个领域开展实验。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is bounded by the four domain experiments and statistical tests reported in the abstract; no independent reproduction, cross-institution validation, or real-world deployment results are provided. The accuracy-efficiency trade-off of Nyström approximation, the scope of convergence guarantees for block coordinate ascent on a non-convex objective, and comprehensive comparisons against other large-scale kernel methods require checking the full paper. The reported speedups and accuracy figures should not be extrapolated as general conclusions.
cards.whyItMatters: 若该框架在更广泛数据与任务上可复现，则可能减少对离散网格搜索调核的依赖，并降低大规模SVM训练的时间开销，为高维非线性分类提供更可扩展的路径。
cards.limitations: 证据边界限于论文摘要所报告的四类领域实验与统计检验；未提供独立复现、跨机构验证或真实部署结果。Nyström近似的精度-效率权衡、块坐标上升在非凸目标下的收敛保证范围、以及相对其他大规模核方法的全面对比，均需查阅原文确认。不应将文中的加速倍数与准确率数字外推为普遍结论。
cards.title: 统一联合优化框架结合Nyström近似实现可扩展自适应SVM
cards.description: 该研究提出将核选择与SVM训练耦合为连续双层次联合优化问题，并引入Nyström低秩近似与块坐标上升算法，在保持精度的同时将训练复杂度从立方级降至O(Nm)，旨在解决经典SVM在大数据下的训练瓶颈与静态核刚性。
cards.summaryEn: Classical SVMs face two main bottlenecks: cubic training complexity and rigid static kernels, with traditional methods decoupling kernel learning from decision-boundary optimization. The paper proposes a "Revisited SVM" unified framework that recasts learning as a continuous bi-level joint optimization problem and derives an objective J(α, θ) for simultaneously optimizing Lagrange multipliers and kernel hyperparameters. A hybrid block coordinate ascent algorithm integrated with Nyström low-rank approximation is used, and experiments across four heterogeneous domains report accuracy matching or exceeding exhaustive grid search with up to 100x training speedups.
cards.titleEn: Unified Joint Optimization with Nyström Approximation for Scalable Adaptive SVM
cards.originalTitle: Revisited Support Vector Machines: A Unified Joint Optimization Framework with Nystr\"om Approximation for Scalable Adaptive Learning
cards.summary: 经典SVM面临训练立方复杂度与静态核选择困难两大瓶颈，传统方法将核学习与决策边界优化分离。本文提出“Revisited SVM”统一框架，将学习过程重述为连续双层次联合优化问题，并给出同时优化拉格朗日乘子与核超参数的目标函数J(α, θ)。作者通过混合块坐标上升算法与Nyström低秩近似进行求解，在四个异构领域的实验中报告了匹配或超越穷举网格搜索的精度以及最高100倍的训练加速。
cards.descriptionEn: This work couples kernel selection and SVM training as a continuous bi-level joint optimization problem, using Nyström low-rank approximation and block coordinate ascent to reduce training complexity from cubic to O(Nm) while aiming to preserve accuracy, addressing classical SVM bottlenecks in the big-data regime.
keyPointsEn: Kernel hyperparameter learning and SVM dual variable optimization are unified as a continuous bi-level joint optimization problem.
Block coordinate ascent is combined with Nyström low-rank approximation to reduce computational complexity to O(Nm).
Experiments span four domains: bioinformatics, finance, cybersecurity, and computer vision.

cards.whyItMattersEn: If distributed GPU failure detection relies on generic log parsing, it may miss or misjudge failures by losing distributed execution context. This work provides a reproducible benchmark for evaluating the trade-off between cost and detection effectiveness, and highlights the need for parsing or analysis methods designed for distributed settings.
keyPoints: GF-Bench提供220个双GPU标注执行，覆盖正常、CUDA OOM与持续拖慢故障。
基于解析日志的四种方法无法可靠检测两类故障，最高总体F1为0.667。
LLM在原始日志上F1达0.983，但输入token用量和单次成本分别增至9.0倍与8.7倍。
cards.limitationsEn: The current release covers only two GPUs, two failure classes (CUDA OOM and persistent straggler), and failures visible in communication logs; other GPU scales, workloads, or failure types are untested. Cost comparisons are based on specific LLM invocation conditions, and extrapolating conclusions requires caution.
cards.whyItMatters: 分布式GPU故障检测若依赖通用日志解析，可能因丢失分布式执行上下文而漏检或误判；该研究为评估成本与检测效果的权衡提供了可复现基准，并提示需针对分布式场景设计解析或分析方法。
cards.limitations: 当前发布仅覆盖双GPU、两类故障（CUDA OOM和持续拖慢）及通信日志可见故障，未验证其他GPU规模、工作负载或故障类型；成本比较基于特定LLM调用条件，结论外推需谨慎。
cards.title: 日志解析抹去分布式GPU故障关键线索
cards.description: 该研究提出GF-Bench框架，用于生成分布式GPU工作负载中的多样故障，并评估现有序列模型与LLM在解析日志和原始日志上的故障检测效果。新在于揭示通用日志解析虽降低开销，却会丢弃分布式执行上下文，导致检测不可靠；对成本敏感的场景有参考价值。
cards.summaryEn: The authors build GF-Bench with 220 labeled two-GPU executions covering normal runs, CUDA OOM, and persistent straggler failures. On parsed logs, DeepLog, LogAnomaly, LogBERT, and LogPrompt do not reliably detect both failure classes, with the highest F1 at 0.667; LogPrompt on raw logs reaches 0.983 F1 but uses 9.0x input tokens and 8.7x per-run cost. The authors argue that generic log parsing creates a substantial trade-off between effectiveness and efficiency in distributed GPU failure detection.
cards.titleEn: Log Parsing Removes Critical Clues for Distributed GPU Failures
cards.originalTitle: When Log Parsing Removes What Matters: Detecting Failures in Distributed GPU Workloads
cards.summary: 作者构建了GF-Bench，含220个双GPU执行样本，覆盖正常、CUDA OOM和持续拖慢故障。基于解析日志，DeepLog、LogAnomaly、LogBERT和LogPrompt均不能可靠检测两类故障，最高F1为0.667；LogPrompt在原始日志上F1达0.983，但输入token用量和单次成本分别增至9.0倍和8.7倍。作者观点是通用日志解析在分布式GPU故障检测中造成效果与效率的显著权衡。
cards.descriptionEn: This study introduces GF-Bench, a framework for generating diverse failures in distributed GPU workloads, and evaluates sequence-based models and LLMs on parsed versus raw logs. Its novelty lies in exposing that generic log parsing reduces cost but discards distributed execution context, undermining failure detection reliability; it is relevant for cost-sensitive analysis.
keyPointsEn: GF-Bench provides 220 labeled two-GPU executions covering normal runs, CUDA OOM, and persistent straggler failures.
On parsed logs, the four evaluated methods cannot reliably detect both failure classes, with the highest overall F1 of 0.667.
LLM on raw logs reaches 0.983 F1 but uses 9.0x input tokens and 8.7x per-run cost.

cards.whyItMattersEn: This study warns that ignoring implementation details in KNN algorithm comparisons may lead to incorrect conclusions; reporting details such as query mode, parameter settings, and micro-optimizations is crucial for reproducibility and fair benchmarking, especially for tasks relying on nearest neighbor search in AI × quantitative finance.
keyPoints: 最优查询策略依赖 k 和数据集：单树搜索在 k=1 时对四个最大数据集中的三个最快，双树搜索在 k≥5 时对三个最大数据集最快，选错查询模式可导致高达 7.5 倍的运行时间差距。
Cover Tree 基参数默认值不安全：理论值 2 和实践值 1.3 均非通用最优，1.3 仅在七个数据集中的一个上最优，在 covtype 上比最优值慢 1.6 倍。
五种微优化中仅提前退出距离计算有一致效果，且随维度增加而增强：d=32 时无效果，d=54 时 1.31 倍，d=784 时 1.49 倍。
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions are based on three Cover Tree construction variants and three query modes, covering only a subset of datasets and parameters, and may not generalize to other KNN algorithms or scenarios. All timing medians are based on 20 independent allocations with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals, but do not cover all possible implementation optimizations or hardware environments.
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究提示，在 KNN 算法比较中忽略实现细节可能导致错误结论；报告查询模式、参数设置和微优化等细节对可复现性和公平基准测试至关重要，尤其对 AI×量化中依赖近邻搜索的任务有直接影响。
cards.limitations: 结论基于 Cover Tree 的三种构建变体和三种查询模式，仅覆盖部分数据集与参数，不一定推广到其他 KNN 算法或场景。所有计时中位数基于 20 次独立分配和自举 95% 置信区间，但未涉及所有可能的实现优化或硬件环境。
cards.title: Cover Tree 实现细节如何显著改变 KNN 性能
cards.description: 通过统一 Rust 实现 RustKNN 系统评估 Cover Tree 的构建与查询变体，揭示查询模式、基参数和微优化对运行时间排序的影响，为基准测试的可复现性提供指导。
cards.summaryEn: This study points out that implementation details of KNN search algorithms are often overlooked in the literature, yet they materially impact performance and can change conclusions about algorithm superiority. Using Cover Tree as an example, the authors implement RustKNN with three construction variants and three query modes, finding that the optimal query strategy depends on k and dataset, the base parameter default is not safe, and micro-optimization effects depend on dimensionality. The study emphasizes that benchmarking should report implementation details and releases open-source code.
cards.titleEn: Cover Tree Implementation Details Can Dramatically Change KNN Performance
cards.originalTitle: KNN Implementation Details Can Dramatically Change Performance: An Example from Cover Trees
cards.summary: 该研究指出 KNN 搜索算法的实现细节在文献中常被忽略，但这些细节会实质性影响性能并改变算法优劣结论。作者以 Cover Tree 为例，用 RustKNN 统一实现三种构建变体和三种查询模式，发现最优查询策略取决于 k 和数据集，基参数默认值并非安全，微优化效果依赖维度。研究强调基准测试需报告实现细节，并公开了开源代码。
cards.descriptionEn: A unified Rust implementation, RustKNN, systematically evaluates Cover Tree construction and query variants, revealing how query mode, base parameter, and micro-optimizations affect runtime rankings and offering guidance for reproducible benchmarking.
keyPointsEn: Optimal query strategy depends on k and dataset: single-tree search is fastest at k=1 on three of the four largest datasets, while dual-tree search is fastest at k≥5 on the three largest; choosing the wrong query mode can cost up to a 7.5× factor in runtime.

The Cover Tree base parameter default is not safe: neither the theoretical value 2 nor the practical value 1.3 is universally optimal; 1.3 is optimal on only one of seven datasets and on covtype it is 1.6× slower than the optimum.
Among five micro-optimizations, only early-exit distance computation has a consistent effect, which grows with dimension: none at d=32, 1.31× at d=54, and 1.49× at d=784.

cards.whyItMattersEn: In stochastic-volatility pricing, sensitivities such as Greeks are often key downstream quantities for risk management and hedging; localized derivative errors can affect later applications even when option values are accurate. This work offers an evaluable architectural direction for structured conditional adaptation of parametric PDE solution families and underscores the need for derivative-aware evaluation.
keyPoints: BeTINN通过多方向时间-参数条件和联合残差通路扩展时间诱导调制，面向参数化PDE解族。
在Heston随机波动率PDE上，BeTINN在期权价值与关键敏感性指标的联合精度上相对基线有所提升。
消融实验刻画各架构组件作用，并指出验证物理损失具有信息性但不能完全决定微分保真度。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on the authors' experiments and ablations on the Heston stochastic-volatility PDE, without cross-model, cross-market data, or independent replication; baseline choices and evaluation metrics are set by the authors, and the magnitude or statistical significance of joint accuracy improvements is not provided in the input. The observed relationship between validation physics loss and differential fidelity is an author observation and should not be generalized. This research does not constitute investment advice or a trading strategy recommendation.
cards.whyItMatters: 随机波动率定价中，希腊字母等敏感性常是下游风险管理与对冲的关键量；若求解器在局部导数上误差较大，即使期权价值准确也可能影响后续应用。该工作为参数化PDE解族的结构化条件适应提供了可评估的架构方向，并强调对导数进行专门评估的必要性。
cards.limitations: 证据基于作者在Heston随机波动率PDE上的实验与消融，未提供跨模型、跨市场数据或独立复现的验证；基线选择与评估指标由作者设定，联合精度提升幅度与统计显著性未在输入中给出。验证物理损失与微分保真度之间的关系为作者观察，不能推广为普遍结论。该研究不构成投资建议或交易策略推荐。
cards.title: 结构化条件神经求解器提升随机波动率定价精度
cards.description: 提出BeTINN结构化条件架构，通过多方向时间-参数条件与联合残差通路，在Heston随机波动率PDE上同时提升期权价值与敏感性精度。
cards.summaryEn: To address the difficulty physics-informed neural networks face in preserving derivative accuracy across heterogeneous parameter regimes, the authors introduce BeTINN, which extends time-induced modulation via multi-directional time-parameter conditioning and a joint residual pathway. On the Heston stochastic-volatility PDE, BeTINN improves joint accuracy across normalized option values and key first- and second-order sensitivities relative to baselines. The authors view the results as supporting structured conditional adaptation and note that validation physics loss does not fully determine differential fidelity; these interpretations are the authors' views and require independent replication.
cards.titleEn: Structured Conditional Neural Solvers Improve Stochastic-Volatility Pricing Accuracy
cards.originalTitle: Beyond Time Induction: Structured Conditional Neural Solvers for Parametric Stochastic-Volatility Pricing
cards.summary: 针对物理信息神经网络在异质参数区域保持导数精度困难的问题，作者提出BeTINN，用多方向时间-参数条件和联合残差通路扩展时间诱导调制。在Heston随机波动率PDE上，BeTINN在归一化期权价值与一阶、二阶敏感性的联合精度上优于基线。作者认为结果支持结构化条件适应，并指出验证物理损失不能完全决定微分保真度；这些判断属于作者观点，尚需独立复现验证。
cards.descriptionEn: BeTINN, a structured conditional architecture, extends time-induced modulation with multi-directional time-parameter conditioning and a joint residual pathway, improving joint accuracy of option values and sensitivities on the Heston stochastic-volatility PDE.
keyPointsEn: BeTINN extends time-induced modulation through multi-directional time-parameter conditioning and a joint residual pathway for parametric PDE solution families.
On the Heston stochastic-volatility PDE, BeTINN improves joint accuracy across option values and key sensitivity metrics relative to baselines.
Ablations characterize architectural component roles and indicate that validation physics loss is informative but does not fully determine differential fidelity.

cards.whyItMattersEn: It converts execution experience into trainable skill-optimization capability rather than one-off inference-time repair, offering a reusable training path for agent skill generation and showing that a smaller dedicated optimizer can match general-purpose LLMs in this role.
keyPoints: 自写技能比无技能低 8–11 分，暴露生成器细化能力不足的问题。
WER 以执行反馈的组相对奖励与混合结果筛选，训练独立于冻结执行器的技能优化器。
在 BFCL v4 多轮与 tau2-bench 上，平均 Pass@1 较无技能基线提升 7.80 与 6.06 分。
cards.limitationsEn: Results are limited to BFCL v4 multi-turn and tau2-bench with the evaluated models and backbones, and do not establish the same effectiveness for other tool sets, executors, or task distributions; the method relies on the availability and reliability of a programmatic verifier and may not apply without one; the text provides no computational cost, training data scale, or failure-case analysis, and compares systematically only against the identical refinement workflow without training rather than against a broader set of existing methods; the scoring and filtering mechanism may introduce bias and requires independent replication.
cards.whyItMatters: 把执行经验转化为可训练的技能优化能力，而不仅是单次任务的推理时修复，为智能体技能生成提供了可复用训练路径，并显示较小规模专用优化器可在此角色上匹配通用大模型。
cards.limitations: 结果限于 BFCL v4 多轮与 tau2-bench 及所评估的模型与骨干，未证明对其他工具集、执行器或任务分布同样有效；训练依赖程序化验证器的可及性与可靠性，缺少验证器时方法可能不适用；文本未给出计算成本、训练数据规模或失败案例分析，除相同精炼流程的对照外未与更多现成方法系统比较；性能打分与筛选机制本身可能引入偏差，需独立复现验证。
cards.title: WER 框架：用执行反馈训练技能优化器，提升工具使用智能体表现
cards.description: 针对智能体自写技能反而比不用技能更差的问题，WER 用「写—执行—精炼」多阶段强化学习训练一个独立于冻结执行器的技能优化器，在 BFCL v4 多轮与 tau2-bench 上取得提升，为技能生成提供可复用训练范式。
cards.summaryEn: The paper notes that expert-written natural language skills can improve tool-using agents, yet agent-authored skills perform 8–11 points worse than using no skill; inference-time loops only repair individual skills per task and leave the underlying generator's refinement capability unimproved. The authors introduce WER, a multi-phase framework that organizes execution experience from intermediate skills into training states and trains a Skill Optimizer outside a frozen executor: the optimizer proposes skills, a frozen agent executes them repeatedly, and a programmatic verifier scores outcomes, which serve as group-relative rewards and filter for informative mixed-outcome instances; matched successful and failed trajectories form the next phase's refinement states. On BFCL v4 multi-turn and tau2-bench, WER improves average Pass@1 over the no-skill baseline by 7.80 and 6.06 points, respectively, and under an identical refinement workflow outperforms the same backbone without optimizer training by 10.02 and 12.50 points; the trained 4B optimizer reaches 76.63% on BFCL v4, outperforming all evaluated off-the-shelf general-purpose LLMs in the same role on average.
cards.titleEn: WER Framework: Training a Skill Optimizer from Execution Feedback to Improve Tool-Using Agents
cards.originalTitle: Write, Execute, Refine: From Skill Follower to Skill Optimizer via Reinforcement Learning from Execution Feedback
cards.summary: 论文指出，专家撰写的自然语言技能能提升工具使用智能体，但智能体自写技能比不使用技能低 8–11 分；推理时循环只能修复单任务技能，不改善生成器的细化能力。作者提出 WER 框架，将中间技能的执行经验组织为训练状态，训练一个与冻结执行器分离的技能优化器；优化器提出技能，冻结智能体重复执行，程序化验证器打分，分数作为组相对奖励并筛选混合结果样本，匹配的成功与失败轨迹构成下一阶段精炼状态。在 BFCL v4 多轮与 tau2-bench 上，WER 相比无技能基线的平均 Pass@1 分别提升 7.80 与 6.06 分，并在相同精炼流程下优于未训练优化器的同骨干模型 10.02 与 12.50 分；训练出的 4B 优化器在 BFCL v4 达到 76.63%，平均优于所评估的同角色现成通用大模型。
cards.descriptionEn: Addressing the finding that agent-authored skills can be worse than using no skill, WER trains a standalone skill optimizer through a Write-Execute-Refine multi-phase reinforcement learning procedure outside a frozen executor, improving results on BFCL v4 multi-turn and tau2-bench and offering a reusable training paradigm for skill generation.
keyPointsEn: Agent-authored skills perform 8–11 points worse than no skill, exposing weak refinement in the generator.
WER trains a skill optimizer outside a frozen executor using group-relative rewards and mixed-outcome filtering from execution feedback.
On BFCL v4 multi-turn and tau2-bench, average Pass@1 improves over the no-skill baseline by 7.80 and 6.06 points.

cards.summary: 事实：GitHub 项目 morluto/rea 的简介称可用智能体逆向工程任何目标，从应用行为到原生二进制。作者观点（隐含）：智能体可覆盖完整的逆向工程层级。注意：该描述尚未提供技术细节、示例或评估结果，无法确认其有效性。

cards.whyItMattersEn: Engineering teams are under pressure to build AI skills, and skill gaps are widespread. This training program claims to effectively boost team AI capabilities and foster continuous learning habits through a systematic curriculum based on job role analysis, potentially helping organizations close the skills gap.
keyPoints: 项目基于对 10,000 多个岗位的分析和专家访谈，识别出最关键的 AI 技能。
BCG 2026 年调查显示，72% 的员工认为 AI 改变了工作所需技能，但仅 36% 觉得得到了充分提升。
DeepLearning.AI 声称通过其企业项目学习的人持续学习的可能性是自学者的五倍。
cards.limitationsEn: This information comes from DeepLearning.AI's promotional material for its enterprise program, without independent verification of research methods or data. The cited BCG survey and the 'five times' claim lack specific research details or sample information. Results may vary by team background, industry, and level of commitment.
cards.whyItMatters: 企业工程团队面临构建 AI 技能的压力，而技能差距普遍存在。该培训项目声称能通过系统化课程和基于岗位分析的内容，有效提升团队 AI 能力并培养持续学习习惯，从而可能帮助企业缩小技能缺口。
cards.limitations: 该信息来自 DeepLearning.AI 的企业项目宣传材料，未提供独立验证的研究方法或数据。所引用的 BCG 调查和“五倍”说法均未给出具体研究细节或样本信息。效果可能因团队基础、行业和投入程度而异。
cards.title: 企业AI技能培训：DeepLearning.AI 推出可信课程方案
cards.description: DeepLearning.AI 发布面向企业的 AI 技能培训项目，旨在帮助团队弥补技能差距。其独特之处在于基于对 10,000 多个岗位的分析和专家访谈设计课程，并宣称参与者持续学习的可能性是自学者的五倍。对于需要系统化提升团队 AI 能力的企业，这一方案提供了可信的参考路径。
cards.summaryEn: DeepLearning.AI launched an enterprise AI skills training program that claims to help teams gain trusted AI skills. The program identifies key skills based on analysis of over 10,000 job roles and interviews with dozens of AI engineering experts. According to its promotion, those learning through the enterprise program are five times more likely to keep learning over time than those learning on their own.
cards.titleEn: Enterprise AI Skills Training: DeepLearning.AI Launches Trusted Program
cards.originalTitle: Give your team AI skills you can trust
cards.summary: DeepLearning.AI 推出企业 AI 技能培训项目，声称能帮助团队获得可信的 AI 技能。该项目基于对超过 10,000 个岗位的分析和数十位 AI 工程专家的访谈来识别关键技能。据其宣传，通过该企业项目学习的人持续学习的可能性是自学者的五倍。
cards.descriptionEn: DeepLearning.AI has released an enterprise AI skills training program aimed at helping teams close skill gaps. Its distinctiveness lies in a curriculum designed from analysis of over 10,000 job roles and expert interviews, with claims that participants are five times more likely to keep learning than self-learners. For organizations seeking systematic AI upskilling, this offers a credible reference path.
keyPointsEn: The program identifies critical AI skills based on analysis of over 10,000 job roles and expert interviews.
BCG's 2026 survey shows 72% of workers say AI has changed what their jobs require, but only 36% feel adequately upskilled.
DeepLearning.AI claims those learning through its enterprise program are five times more likely to keep learning than self-learners.
